text:
## Waiting

In this hypothetical queue, each job takes a minute. Ten jobs arrive together and the worker runs them one at a time. The last job waits nine minutes before it starts.

## What to try next

Add a second worker and repeat the same ten-job batch. If both workers take jobs as soon as they are free, the final two jobs start after four minutes. This assumes the workers do not compete for another resource.
